arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
# Expenses section: rows index 10..21 (Excel rows 11..22), category col 0, amount col 2
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 2]].dropna(subset=[2])
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Amount']
print('Total expenses (all categories):', exp['Amount'].sum())
print(exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum().to_string())
# Cross-check with template SUM range C11:C22 via openpyxl cached/formula check
print('Expense line count:', len(exp))
"
